result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but there is a minor layout issue where the last visible restaurant card is cut off at the bottom of the screen, indicating a need for better spacing or scrollability.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient bottom padding or margin on the scrollable content area so that the last item is not obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar.
